title: Release gate with review card
request: Release gate agent. When the user writes 'release <version> of <service>', reply 'Release <service> <version>?' with a review card whose summary rows include Service and Version, an Approve button (selection {"action":"approve","service":"<service>","version":"<version>"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"reject","service":"<service>","version":"<version>"}). On approve reply 'Released <service> <version>'. On reject reply 'Release of <service> <version> blocked'.
